instructions.question: How does sentence `sentences.$sentence` relate to the sentences before it in this dictated note?
instructions.focus: This is spoken dictation transcribed as one block, with fillers. Judge from the words only; the sentences keep their order and wording.

continues.what: Continues the same thought or topic as the previous sentence; running prose.
continues.not_for: A sentence that opens a new topic, or that is one entry of an enumeration.

new_paragraph.what: Starts a clearly different topic, request or step than the previous sentence, where a writer would begin a new paragraph.
new_paragraph.not_for: Elaboration, examples or a follow-up of the previous sentence.
examples: Okay, now the second thing I want to talk about is the settings page.

list_item.what: One entry in an enumeration of parallel items, often introduced with words such as first, secondly, thirdly, one, two, three, next, finally.
list_item.not_for: A sentence that merely mentions a number or an order.
examples: First of all, we don't want to make it very long.
Secondly, we want to add tags.
Three, I don't see any formatting.
